description: A React component implementing a team sidebar with drag-and-drop, keyboard navigation, and team switching functionalities for Mattermost.

classes.name: TeamSidebar
classes.description: A React component managing the display and interaction of the team sidebar, including team switching, reordering, and rendering team buttons.

methods.name: switchToPrevOrNextTeam
methods.description: Handles switching to the previous or next team based on keyboard arrow keys.

methods.name: switchToTeamByNumber
methods.description: Switches to a team based on number key shortcuts.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for team navigation shortcuts.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events to reset team order display.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates WebSocket active team when current team changes.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes team fetching and event listeners.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles reordering of teams after drag-and-drop.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the team sidebar UI including team buttons, join/create options, and plugins.
